main_idea: GRPO lifts Qwen3.8-27B DeepSWE pass@1 from 27.8% to 39.1%
ideas: GRPO raises DeepSWE pass@1 from 27.8% to 39.1%
Gain is +11.3 points on the same mini-swe-agent setup
Training data: 500 tasks from a 10,000+ task dataset
Mean training reward rises from 0.570 to 0.856
Training tasks are mostly feature requests
Entropy stays stable with no sustained decline
summary: The before/after bar chart is a clear core, but a large stat card repeats it, and the reward chart, task-type chart, dataset stats row and entropy footer are extras that should go; the long subtitle and footer URL should shrink or go.
